title: kbtools.py lists the kb MCP tools by the environment of the run and misses docs_search and docs_fetch
goal: kbtools.py lists every kb MCP tool the server can serve, whatever the environment of the run (live-docs, coord and backlog-write tools included), so two runs in two environments print the same catalog

run:
import os, subprocess, sys

def catalog(extra):
    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k not in ('KB_COORD_TOOLS', 'KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS')}
    env.update(extra)
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/kbtools.py'], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
    return r.returncode, r.stdout

rc0, plain = catalog({})
rc1, gated = catalog({'KB_COORD_TOOLS': '1', 'KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS': '1'})
live = [n for n in ('docs_search', 'docs_fetch') if n not in plain]
print('exit', rc0, rc1, '| live-docs tools missing from the catalog:', live, '| same catalog with the gated tools switched on:', plain == gated)
sys.exit(0 if rc0 == 0 and rc1 == 0 and not live and plain == gated else 1)

notes: Parked by the review of SP-x6eqtsid (reviewer, 2026-10-24; S2). kbtools.mcp_entries imports kb_mcp and calls tools/list in a bare process: LIVE_ON is set only by kb_mcp.main(), so docs_search and docs_fetch never show, and the coord and backlog-write tools show only when KB_COORD_TOOLS or KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS is set in the shell (24 MCP lines with it, 16 with another variable). The kb_tools MCP child inherits the same. Goal clauses of ST-w6pz5emu and ST-e6xp5h3u: the catalog lists the kb MCP tools and kb_tools returns its lines.
